notes.title: [PLACEHOLDER] Thresholds
notes.science: [PLACEHOLDER] Some people join only when enough friends already have.
notes.limits: [PLACEHOLDER] Here each creature has one fixed threshold.
notes.counter: [PLACEHOLDER] Some joiners follow strangers, not friends.
notes.question: [PLACEHOLDER] How many friends would it take for you to dance?

notes.title: [PLACEHOLDER] Friends across a gap
notes.science: [PLACEHOLDER] A dance spreads through friendships, wherever the friends stand.
notes.limits: [PLACEHOLDER] Here a bridge only lets creatures cross; the dance follows ties, not paths.
notes.counter: [PLACEHOLDER] Some say being near matters more than being friends.
